The sun lifts it up, and in winter it falls down. Then the snow is old water! It is older than your grandmother, child.

title: A Guest from the Warm Country

plan.english: Be well, friend! Is the winter long here? It is long. Snow lies on the fields, and the rivers stand. In your village, do you freeze in winter? In my village the winter is short, and the sun is warm. Then why did you come to our cold village? I seek horses. They are swift. In the morning I will show them to you.

title: In the Shade of the Oak

plan.english: Of-True-Fame, I am sweating. The sun is hot. Let the oxen rest. Let us sit down in the shade of the oak. I am thirsty. Drink from the skin. In the heat of the day a wise man rests.
